evidence: The paper uses random forest only for weight estimation via classification of subgroup membership: "We estimate p(s|y,x) by multinomial logistic regression or by random forest, using the implementation in the R packages glmnet [14] and ranger [43], respectively." Variable selection is performed via lasso-regularized Cox regression: "We use a lasso penalty for variable selection and yields a sparse model solution." Results are reported using regression coefficients and mean inclusion frequency (MIF) of selected genes, not random forest impurity importance.
